Compute subgroup proportions within an enrollment grouping

Source: R/01_trend_enrollment.R
compute_enrollment_proportions.Rd

For each variable in subgroup_vars, computes the proportion of students in each category within the specified by grouping. Returns a long-format data frame with one row per by-group × subgroup variable × subgroup value.

Usage

compute_enrollment_proportions(
  data,
  by,
  subgroup_vars = NULL,
  assessment_spec,
  denominator = "total_by_year",
  min_n = 10
)

Arguments

data

A long-format student results data frame (see data contract).

by

Character vector of grouping column names (e.g. c("YEAR", "GRADE")).

subgroup_vars

Character vector of demographic column names to compute proportions for. Defaults to names(assessment_spec$demographics).

assessment_spec

Named list describing the assessment program.

denominator

Character scalar controlling what counts as the total enrollment for proportion calculation. One of:

  • "total_by_year" — all students in that year (default)

  • "total_overall" — all students across all years

  • "within_grade" — students in that year × grade

  • "within_school" — students in that year × school

  • "within_district" — students in that year × district

min_n

Integer. Cells with N < min_n have their pct set to NA. Default 10.

Value

A long-format data frame with columns: by grouping columns, subgroup_var (the demographic variable name), subgroup_val (the category), N (count), total_N (denominator), pct (proportion × 100), suppressed.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
source(system.file("specs/00_DEMO_Assessment_Spec.R", package = "ReportR"))
compute_enrollment_proportions(demo_data, by = "YEAR", assessment_spec)
} # }
